Thanks for the quick turn, Vivek. Answers inline below.

> 1) Baseline traffic expectations — can you provide a 7-day sample or an estimate (reqs/sec, avg tokens/request, percent streaming vs non-streaming)?
Hannah (from earlier discussions): target 100 concurrent users at peak, ~350k tokens/day initially. Most calls will be short chat-style (non-streaming) but support summarization jobs will be batched overnight.

> 2) Data residency / compliance — do you need Dedicated/Private for contractual reasons (PCI/SOC2 controls)?
Hannah: they require SOC 2 evidence and data segregation. They are open to Hosted with contractual controls, but would prefer Dedicated if cost/project timeline allows.

> 3) Auth & secrets — will Starkwell provide a service account for us to test, or shall we use pre-production API keys?
Hannah: will provide a service account in their AWS account (IT will send role ARN). IT contact is cc'd.
